item.description: A plain-language summary of new research on bone density screening in adults with celiac disease, exploring when bone scans are most useful and how early bone loss can affect long-term fracture risk.

item.title: When "Gluten Sensitivity" Isn
item.description: Many people diagnosed with gluten sensitivity or lactose intolerance may actually have alpha-gal syndrome, a tick-borne meat allergy. Learn how this overlooked condition causes delayed digestive symptoms and why it matters for people with celiac disease.

item.title: Celiac.com Video News: February 2026

item.description: As disability accommodations surge on elite campuses, students with celiac disease and gluten sensitivity may face increased skepticism, risk, and reduced support. Here’s why it matters.

item.title: Mild Symptoms, Serious Risks: The Overlooked Type of Celiac Disease in Kids
item.description: New research shows that a subtle form of celiac disease in children affects only a small part of the intestine but carries similar autoimmune risks. Learn why accurate diagnosis matters.

item.title: Why Some People Develop Celiac Disease Instead of Type One Diabetes?
item.description: New research shows how subtle genetic differences may steer autoimmune risk toward celiac disease instead of type one diabetes, helping explain why shared genes lead to different outcomes.

item.title: One in Four Kids With Celiac Disease Have Anemia at Diagnosis, Study Finds
item.description: A new study explores how common iron deficiency anemia is in children with celiac disease and how it improves after starting a gluten-free diet. Learn what the findings mean for screening, treatment, and long-term monitoring.

item.title: Nearly One-Third of IBS Patients Report Gluten Sensitivity, New Study Finds (+Video)
item.description: A large Italian study finds that nearly 30% of young adults with irritable bowel syndrome also report nonceliac gluten sensitivity, with more whole-body symptoms and higher use of gluten-free diets.
